title: Fake Chinese Loan-App Scam / Money-Laundering Cluster
dataset_purpose: Benchmark OSINT ingestion, entity resolution, relationship extraction, temporal graph construction, source provenance, and uncertainty handling.
legal_notice: This dataset records public-source reporting, agency claims, prosecution allegations, and court-recorded material. It does not establish guilt. Status fields must be preserved by downstream systems.
created_for: AI-Powered Criminal Network Analysis System prototype / SIH26189
source_scope: Publicly available ED releases, Kerala High Court judgment, and news reports.
known_scope_notes: ED reported different aggregate figures at different stages of the investigation; these are retained as separate observations rather than normalized away.
A news report spells Daniel Selvakumar's name as Daniel Shivakumar; the official ED release uses Daniel Selvakumar. Preserve both as source variants.
Names such as Leema/Leema and Angel/Angel appear in court-recorded prosecution material; they should not be treated as adjudicated criminal findings.
